# MediaViewer

A full-screen viewer for artwork, photos and track waveforms with zoom and pan, caption with source and alt text, previous/next, and close.

`SongNodes.MediaViewer` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.MediaViewer items={…} index={0} open />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.MediaViewer" items="{{…}}" index="{{0}}" open="{{yes}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (MediaViewerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `MediaItem[]` | Items to page through. |
| `index` * | `number` | Index shown first. |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state (full-screen, modal). |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Close handler (close button, Esc); focus returns to the thumbnail that opened it. |
| `onIndexChange` | `(index: number) => void` | Called when prev/next or the arrow keys change the item. |
| `maxZoom` | `number` | Maximum zoom (default 4 = 400%). |

### MediaItem

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `"artwork" \| "photo" \| "waveform"` | Kind of media. |
| `src` * | `string \| (() => ReactNode)` | Image URL or a render function for the waveform. |
| `title` * | `string` | Caption title: "Bicep – Glue (cover art)". |
| `source` * | `string` | Source line: "Beatport · 1,400 × 1,400". |
| `alt` * | `string` | Alt text; always shown in the caption and used as the accessible name. |
